generation.scope: For triple-line and double-plus-simple-line determinants the only irreducible auxiliary pencils are two explicit one-parameter normal forms. The target parameter is -k/2, and a single adjugate rank test recovers every lift without a scalar-plus-rank-one generator. Compression pairs and the zero-generator quadric recover all other lifts. This completes ordered three-commutator inversion for every non-identically-zero determinant, covering the commutator equation for arbitrary fixed symmetric data on the finite q=3, g>3 branch. Full AS and unmarked classification remain open.

open_mathematics: Turn to the general marked branch with q,g>3. Use the linear trace identities of prescribed mixed brackets [Q_i,P_j] to compress the inverse to two linear spaces and a rank-one tensor in their product. Test injectivity on actual high-opposite-rank regular seeds and at generic moment-zero representatives.
